about_the_game:
This is the legacy soundtrack for the free prologue chapter of ColorBlend FX: Desaturation.

Includes only the music found in the demo, and will soon be superseded by the new release.

All tracks are composed by DarksSilencer. 

Best experienced with open-back headphones.
